_key_label: anyCreature 1.2.0 — PUBLIC BY DESIGN. This is an anonymous UGC submission key, meant to ship inside the package; it grants nothing but the right to post to the community wall, and abuse is bounded server-side by rate limiting and review. It is not a secret and finding it in the repo is not a leak. Note that rotating it does not retract it — old keys stay readable in git history, so retirement has to happen server-side.
